item: L2-2 frozen fixture model: an MLX-format 4-bit instruct model of at most 3B parameters, repo id and revision pinned at freeze
why: The server must start with one fixed model for both groups. pin_model.py records the commit and the SHA-256 of every file; nothing is downloaded or committed here. Candidates below are from memory and were not fetched: confirm each exists, is not gated, has a 4-bit MLX quantization in config.json, and has its weights and chat template in standard files. Prefer a mainstream non-reasoning architecture so that any MLX-based server can load it.

item: L2-3/L2-4 pinned official openai Python client
why: The checks must use the official openai package at a fixed version, in a grader venv outside the test user's PATH. This repo's own lock already uses openai 3.40.0 (Python 3.12), and client_check.py was tested with it against stub_server.py. The macOS /usr/bin/python3 here is 3.9.6; confirm the chosen version supports the grader's Python.

candidates.source: https://pypi.org/project/openai/ (version 3.40.0, or the latest release at freeze)
candidates.pin: pip install openai==<version> in /Users/Shared/eval-grader/venv; commit `pip freeze` as grader-requirements.lock and record its SHA-256 in calibration.md
